// A generalized epicycloid: the traced point sits PoleDistance from the center
// of the rolling circle rather than on its rim (spirograph curves)
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Epitrochoid).
type Epitrochoid2D
    implements ICurve2D
{
    FixedRadius: Number;
    RollingRadius: Number;
    PoleDistance: Number;
}
